name: Chicken Caesar Salad with Yogurt Dressing & Garlic Croutons

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Cube bread and transfer to a sheet pan.
Peel and press or mince garlic. Drizzle bread with oil and sprinkle with ¾ of the garlic (save the rest for dressing), parsley flakes, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 cloves garlic
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp parsley flakes
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place in the oven and bake until golden brown and crispy, 8-10 minutes.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.681 kg boneless skinless chicken breasts
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side.
Wash and dry lettuce. Halve lengthwise, then chop crosswise into 1 inch strips.

In a medium bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together remaining garlic, 6 tbsp of the grated Parmesan (save the rest for garnishing), yogurt, lemon juice, oil, Dijon, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
¾ lemon
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp Worcestershire sauce
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut remaining lemons into wedges. Slice chicken into strips.
To serve, arrange a bed of lettuce on a plate and top with chicken and croutons. Drizzle with dressing, sprinkle with remaining Parmesan, and serve with lemon wedges. Enjoy!
